branding.tagline: One place for identity, access, and audit — designed for your team, in your language.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your organizational account to continue.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your account email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgotPassword.success: If an account matches that email, we'll send instructions shortly.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter the reset token from your email and set a strong password.
resetPassword.success: Password updated. You can now sign in.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

sessionExpired.title: Session expired
sessionExpired.description: For your security we signed you out. Please sign in again to continue.

accessDenied.title: Access denied
accessDenied.description: You don't have permission to view this page. If you believe this is a mistake, contact your administrator.

maintenance.title: We're doing a quick tune-up
maintenance.description: The portal is temporarily unavailable while we deploy an update. We'll be back shortly.

captcha.label: Security check
captcha.loadError: Could not load the security check. Try refreshing.

errors.accountLocked: This account is locked. Contact your administrator.
errors.mfaInvalid: The code you entered is invalid or already used.
errors.mfaExpired: This verification challenge has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.resetTokenInvalid: The reset link is invalid or expired.
errors.captchaInvalid: The security check answer is incorrect. Please try again.
errors.captchaExpired: The security check expired. A new image has been loaded.
errors.captchaRequired: Complete the security check to continue.
